name: lec-lerka
description: Valeriia's personal Claude Code skills, shared across projects

plugins.name: review
plugins.description: PR review that follows each project's own rules and the review history already on its pull requests (Important / Nit findings, each verified, posted inline with a count summary), and safe resolution of a PR's merge conflicts.

plugins.name: workflow
plugins.description: Everyday delivery for any repo, following my way of working: deliver-pr (ticket and design first, branch naming, commits authored by me and committed by Claude, labels, PR description), answer-review (blocking first, reply to every comment, repeat until no review blocks), plus update-agents-md, mirror-sibling-change and fix-test-imports.

plugins.name: guard
plugins.description: Safety hooks for every shell command Claude runs: no pushes to protected branches (main, master, staging, production), no deleting remote branches without asking, no env files, keys or secrets in a commit, a task-tracker reminder after a PR is opened or merged, and a check before finishing that edited code was tested. If a project ships its own copy at .claude/hooks/claude-guard.js, this one steps aside for that session.

plugins.name: i18n
plugins.description: Translations in every language: translation-check (a dependency-free script comparing every locale with the reference for missing keys, placeholders, plural forms, untranslated text and forbidden words) and translation-review (a per-language editor's review of meaning, terms, formality, grammar and length).

plugins.name: planning
plugins.description: Tickets to release: write-ticket (a bug or idea becomes a ticket with acceptance criteria on the tracker page), staging-retest-plan (one living plan, updated in place: new merges added, tested parts removed, results turned into Tested marks), release-pr (the staging → production PR with tickets, migrations, env vars, flags, risks and rollback), artifact-cleanup (propose old or superseded artifacts and leftovers, delete only what you confirm) and delete-tested-designs (designs whose tickets are Tested on staging: rescue what's open, unlink from the tracker, delete on confirmation).
